owner: Dr Johnny Aoun and the team
summary: A founder led team of 11 doctors, WhatsApp and PayLater are strengths, but two near identical numbers and staging leftovers appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The Call button appears to use +974 3382 3222 while the Urgent Dental Support banner and footer use +974 3342 3222.
findings.cost: In a dental emergency, a patient may dial the wrong number and call another clinic.

findings.problem: Booking appears to be request only, 'Send a request and the clinic team will contact you', with no available slots shown, and the 20% off whitening offer says Limited time only with no end date.
findings.cost: Patients who must wait for a callback often book elsewhere, and an undated offer builds no urgency.
findings.fix: Live booking slots and a dated offer.

findings.problem: Partner logos appear to use raw file names such as WhatsAppImage2026-08-08 and /manus-storage/ paths, and the Privacy Policy and Terms appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Staging leftovers and dead legal links hurt trust and compliance.
findings.fix: Clean logos and real policy pages.

findings.problem: Copy appears to include 'Clear Aligners clear aligners', 'clinical Specialists' beside 10 specialists with 11 profiles listed, and the Google reviews button appears to open a generic search.
findings.cost: Small errors and unlinked reviews weaken proof.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a direct Google reviews link.

redesign: One phone number and live booking.
Clean logos, policy pages and a dated offer.
Direct review link and proofread copy.
